title: Follow the Airflow Through a Centrifugal Fan
description: Place eleven part cards along the air path of a belt-driven Arrangement 9 SWSI centrifugal fan: eight into numbered slots 1 to 8 in airflow order and three into 'Not in the air path'. Two submissions; correct cards lock, wrong ones return with feedback, and the air path animates at the end.

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
educational.topic: The air path through a centrifugal fan
learningObjectives: The learner will list, in airflow order, the eight parts that air passes through in a ducted, belt-driven SWSI centrifugal fan, and set aside the three parts that stay out of the air path.

simulation.modelType: classification (ordered placement against a rule table)
rules: Eleven cards, eight numbered slots, one bin; each slot holds one card, the bin any number.
A submission is accepted only when all 11 cards are placed.
Correct cards lock; on submission 1 wrong cards return to the pile with their Why text and the misconception they reflect; after submission 2 every correct position is revealed.
Mastery: all 11 cards correct within two submissions.
assumptions: Belt-driven SWSI centrifugal fan, Arrangement 9, ducted on both sides.
limitations: Schematic side view; the scroll and cutoff are marked on the housing rather than drawn in a drive-side view.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Retrieval practice: order the parts by the path of the air, with distractors that do not touch the air
keyQuestions: Where does the air enter the impeller?
Which part separates the air that is leaving from the air that is still circling?
Which parts of an Arrangement 9 fan never touch the air?
commonMisconceptions: Air enters the impeller at the blade tips (it enters at the center, through the inlet funnel).
The cutoff is at the inlet (it is just upstream of the outlet).
Every part of a fan touches the air (in a belt-driven Arrangement 9 fan the bearings and motor sit outside the airstream).
assessmentOpportunities: 'Cards correct: n of 11' after each submission; mastery is all 11 cards correct within two submissions.
